about.heading: About this service
about.body: OpenEduLab is a source-available teaching tool, not open-source software with commercial-use rights. Experiments, favorites and recent use need an account; the site's experiment implementations are original to this project.
about.privacyBody: Your account keeps the email address or phone number you registered with (for sign-in only; the page shows a masked version), a password hash, your favorites, which experiments you opened, and — only when you press save — one set of parameters per entry you saved in (the tool itself, or a curriculum chapter). Usage events are a fixed list of categories — never slider values, typed text or page URLs. No student records and no advertising trackers.
about.unverified: Registering an email address or phone number does not prove that you own it, so no self-service recovery is offered yet.
about.licensePending: Original project code is source-available for noncommercial use under the repository LICENSE. Others need the copyright holder's prior written permission for commercial use. Textbooks, third-party materials, and user data are excluded.
